summary: W19 — the added Build load week (Adj #204) and the last full week before the W20 deload. Four of five sessions banked after today. Wednesday's §10 cut-down PASSED: goal-pace mile ran 4 s/mi faster than 6:55 at RPE 9, so Tier C is confirmed, both pace questions shut (Adj #320/#321). Tuesday was the best accessory session of the Build — the pushdown's load drop produced its first completed 4x12 (Adj #315), and both DB lateral and crunch gates met (Adj #313/#317). Monday's long was under-filled at 60:00 of the 70-min ask (Adj #309). Fri/Sat swapped by athlete directive (4th instance of the shape): Fri = Hyp B (lat 170 fires, DB lateral reverts 35, pushdown takes 47.5 on the rope), Sat = VO2 5x1000m @ I. The incline stalled a second week at 160 and its linear progression is called at its ceiling (Adj #312). Fitness gap unchanged: ~22:45 equivalent against a 21:30 goal, ~75-80 s for Sharpen to find, arbitrated next at the W23 tune-up Fri 9-25.
